subject: Galeopterus variegatus
creator: Eric Lopes
alt: A young colugo with a gray-brown face and dark striped coat peers out beside the tree trunk from the fur of its red-brown mother.
detail: A gray-brown juvenile peers out beside maternal fur, with the wider source frame confirming the carried young. Gliding, hiding and the remembered wish for another journey are fiction. The reddish mother is a separate character, not adult Pippa.
